SINERGO.MenuHint: Connect this world to its Sinergo campaign with a code. Party members' characters stay in sync while you have Foundry open, and downtime rewards you approve in Sinergo are applied here.
SINERGO.AddressHint: Filled in for you. Change it only for a self-hosted Sinergo.
SINERGO.TokenHint: Only if you cannot use a code: create a token in Sinergo → Manage → Foundry → Advanced. Stored in this browser only.
SINERGO.TokenStored: stored — leave empty to keep it
SINERGO.Preview: Party members that will be synced ({parties})
SINERGO.Synced: Sinergo: synced the world and {count} characters.
SINERGO.SyncFailed: Sinergo could not sync the world. The notification above says why.
SINERGO.NoPartyMembers: No characters are in a party. Sinergo follows the members of this world's pf2e parties: add the player characters to the Party in the Actors sidebar.
SINERGO.NotActiveGM: Another GM is connected and is Foundry's active GM, so their browser sends updates. Connecting here still works; changes are sent once.
SINERGO.ErrNotConfigured: Sinergo is not connected yet. Open Game Settings → Configure Settings → Sinergo → Connect campaign.
SINERGO.ErrUnreachable: Could not reach Sinergo at {url}. Check the server address.
SINERGO.ErrMixed: Foundry is served over HTTPS, so the browser blocks a plain http:// address. Use the https:// address shown in Sinergo.
SINERGO.ErrAuth: Sinergo did not accept the sync token — it may have been revoked. Create a new one in your campaign in Sinergo → Foundry.
SINERGO.ErrWrongWorld: That sync token belongs to a campaign connected to a different Foundry world. Use the token from this world's campaign.
SINERGO.ErrProtocol: This version of the Sinergo module is out of date. Update it in Add-on Modules.
SINERGO.ConnectIntro: One world, one campaign. Get a code here and type it in Sinergo, in the campaign for this world, under Manage → Foundry.
SINERGO.CodeSteps: In Sinergo, open the campaign for this world → Manage → Foundry, and type this code:
SINERGO.CodeWaiting: Waiting for Sinergo… the code works for {minutes} more minutes.
SINERGO.CodeExpired: That code expired before it was used. Get a new one.
SINERGO.Connected: This world is connected to Sinergo.
SINERGO.Advanced: Advanced: server address and manual token
SINERGO.ErrNoServer: This copy of the module does not know which Sinergo to use. Open Advanced and enter the server address.
SINERGO.RewardNoCharacter: {name} is not a character in this world, so the reward was not applied.
SINERGO.RewardPartial: Applying this reward to {name} stopped part-way earlier. Check the sheet, fix it by hand, then mark it applied in Sinergo.
SINERGO.RewardNoItem: The item “{item}” could not be found in Foundry, so nothing was applied.
SINERGO.RewardNoGold: {name} needs {need} but has {has}, so nothing was applied.
SINERGO.RewardNoCondition: “{slug}” is not a pf2e condition, so nothing was applied.
SINERGO.RewardNoHP: {name} has no hit points to reduce, so nothing was applied.
SINERGO.RewardStopped: Applying the reward to {name} stopped part-way: {error}. Check the sheet before doing anything else.
